body:
I have used ecstasy for a period of year once every week.  So that is about little over 50 pills.  I have stopped using it for about a month now and I noticed that I am having severe sleeping problems. This is the only side effect I have so far.  I tried using sleeping pills and it has not worked. I basically close my eyes and I get no sleep at all.  However, I do not feel particularly fatigued or sleepy during the day. I do feel slightly sleepy here and there during the day.  I dont understand what to do about this...i wonder if my brain is damaged?
